preconditions.description: Contract must have a positive BNB balance (native currency)
Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)

exploit_hint: The contract has a receive() function that allows it to accept BNB, but there's no protected withdrawal mechanism. As the contract owner, directly call the sendBNBToAdmin function (if accessible) or exploit the swapAndLiquify mechanism to drain BNB. Alternatively, use the _setReceiverWallet function to change the admin wallet to the attacker's address, then trigger the sendBNBToAdmin function through normal token transfers that accumulate fees in the contract.
